title: Coast Guard rescues 2 adrift boaters off Boca Grande during Tropical Storm Debby
description: A Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter crew rescued two adrift boaters after their 34-foot sailing vessel lost its sail 73 miles off Boca Grande, August 4, 2024. The boaters were taken to Air Station Clearwater with no reported injuries. (U.S. Coast Guard Video)
